title: Prisma — A Collective for Pure Vision
features: Inset cinematic hero, hanging navigation pill, oversized Prisma identity, pull-up typography, scroll-linked character reveal, three workflow detail dialogs, four responsive feature cards and locally validated lab inquiry demo.
limitations: React/TypeScript/Tailwind/framer-motion are replaced by native HTML/CSS/JavaScript. Original animated light-field artwork replaces unlicensed hero and feature videos. Join the lab is an explicitly local demo and sends no data; feature tools are explanatory, not live AI integrations.
